q1_issues.issue: The bare plural 'Tickets' is given a group witness, which the determiner rule reserves for definite / demonstrative / possessed plurals — a bare plural is routed to the generic kind — so the quantificational route taken is not the one the instruction set specifies.
Having taken the group route with a distributive predicate, the parse emits no per-member (PartOf $x sk_group_1) distribution rule alongside the group event, which the grouped-plural rule requires.

q2_gaps: episodic / existential bare plural subject ('Tickets will go on sale next Tuesday') — the determiner rule sends a bare plural to a generic kind rule, which is wrong for a one-off future occurrence, and no specific-plural route is provided
notes: 'go on sale' kept as one undecomposed surface symbol, Patient for the non-physical change of status, Future from 'will', and 'next Tuesday' as a bare (Weekday tuesday) with no week arithmetic are all right.
